_source: Tests/API/CreatePR.xaml (automation, data-driven from Data Fabric OfatTestData / data set API_CreatePR) and specs/API_Findings.md section 9.5.
name: API CreatePR: create purchase requisition via REST, cancel refused while Incomplete, delete cleans up
description:
Data-driven API test of the Oracle Fusion purchase requisition REST resource (fscmRestApi 11.13.18.05, US1 Business Unit, dev16). Test Manager runs it once per record of data set API_CreatePR in the Data Fabric entity OfatTestData (records are read when the run starts, so rows can be added or changed without republishing).

For a row expecting 201 it creates a requisition (POST purchaseRequisitions), checks it is Incomplete, checks Oracle refuses to cancel it (POR-2010919, 'You must delete it'), deletes it and confirms it is gone. For a row expecting an error it checks the create is rejected with the row's error code and that no requisition was created. No UI is used.

Automation: Tests\API\CreatePR.xaml in package OF-AT-RobP (Studio test case id bff913c0-a5f6-4c24-b17d-a875d61412d2; data source .variations\OfatTestData_API_CreatePR.json, filter DataSet = API_CreatePR). Each row is parsed strictly by Workflows\Common_ParseTestRow.xaml. Calls use UiPath.WebAPI HTTP Request with Basic auth from credential asset Oracle_Fusion_P2P_Test (folder Shared/OracleFusion), read inside each call's scope; write calls do not retry. A Finally block deletes the requisition if a step fails after it was created.

Verified 2026-11-26 (local runs): row 1 requisition 204191 and row 2 requisition 204192, 7/7 checks each; row 3 rejected with POR-2010313, 3/3 checks.
preCondition:
1. Oracle Fusion dev16 REST reachable: https://fa-eqjz-dev16-saasfademo1.ds-fa.oraclepdemos.com/fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05
2. Credential asset Oracle_Fusion_P2P_Test (Shared/OracleFusion) signs in as CASEY.BROWN, a requester in US1 Business Unit.
3. Data Fabric entity OfatTestData holds at least one record with DataSet = API_CreatePR (otherwise Test Manager marks the case Failed without running it). RowData is a JSON object of text values with: Scenario, BusinessUnit, RequesterEmail, DestinationOrganizationId (blank = leave out), DeliverToLocation, Category, Supplier, SupplierSite, Price, ExpectedCreateStatus, ExpectedDocumentStatus, ExpectedErrorCode.
4. Current rows: 1 create 10.00 USD (expect 201, Incomplete); 2 create 25.50 USD (expect 201, Incomplete); 3 missing destination organization (expect 400, POR-2010313).
postCondition: No requisition is left in Oracle for any row: created requisitions are deleted by the test step, or by the Finally safety cleanup if a step failed. Each run's log lists the row, scenario, requisition number and every HTTP status.

steps.d: Given 1 Test data: one OfatTestData record of data set API_CreatePR is bound to the run (Test Manager runs the case once per record). Parse its RowData strictly with Workflows\Common_ParseTestRow.xaml and convert ExpectedCreateStatus, Price and DestinationOrganizationId to numbers.
steps.e: Row parsed. An empty row, invalid JSON, a missing field, a non-text value or a number that does not convert fails the run with an ArgumentException naming the data set, row and problem.

steps.d: Given 2 Build the request body from the row: header RequisitioningBU, PreparerEmail, ExternallyManagedFlag = false, Description 'UIP-TEST-API-<RunId> CreatePR row <n>'; one Goods line with CategoryName, Quantity 1, UOM Ea, Price, CurrencyCode USD, RequesterEmail, DestinationTypeCode EXPENSE, DestinationOrganizationId (left out when blank), DeliverToLocationCode, Supplier, SupplierSite.
steps.e: Request body ready for the row's scenario.

steps.d: When 1 Create: POST /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/purchaseRequisitions (Content-Type application/json, Basic auth from the credential asset).
steps.e: HTTP status equals the row's ExpectedCreateStatus. When 201: a Requisition number is returned and DocumentStatus equals ExpectedDocumentStatus (Incomplete). When rejected: the message contains ExpectedErrorCode (for example POR-2010313 for a missing destination organization).

steps.d: When 2 Cancel (only if created): POST /purchaseRequisitions/{RequisitionHeaderId}/action/cancel with {"cancelReason": "<description> cancel"} (Content-Type application/vnd.oracle.adf.action+json).
steps.e: HTTP 400. Message contains POR-2010919: 'You can't cancel a requisition or a requisition line if it's incomplete. You must delete it.'
HTTP 200 with count = 0 (the requisition no longer exists).

steps.d: Then: check the outcomes against the row. Rows expecting 201 - create status, number returned, status Incomplete, cancel 400, POR-2010919, delete 204, 0 rows. Rows expecting an error - create status, error code, no requisition created.
steps.e: All checks for the row pass and are recorded in the result; each message starts with '[row <n>: <scenario>]'.

steps.d: Cleanup (Finally): if a requisition was created but the delete did not return 204, delete it.
steps.e: No UIP-TEST-API requisition remains in Oracle after the run, pass or fail.
